# Load required libraries
```{r, echo = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(haven)
library(here)           # sets directory path
library(ggplot2)        # plotting functionality including attr for labels
library(knitr)          # enables running code from RMD file
library(here)           # could not get this to work with Proton Drive
library(RColorBrewer)   # RColorBrewer provides color palettes for plots
```

# Set home folder
```{r, echo = FALSE}
#here() starts at /Users/james-macbook/Data/dissertation
here::i_am("Gallup_Institutions_Confidence.Rmd")
```

# Load data 
```{r, echo = FALSE}

milcon <- read_csv("Gallup_Confidence_Military_1991-2016.csv")
``` 


# Create plot
```{r, echo = FALSE}
milconf <- ggplot(data = milcon,
            mapping = aes(x = Time, y = Aggregate))
milconf + geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Confidence",
     title = "High Confidence in the Military",
     subtitle = "1991-2016",
     caption = "Source: Gallup")
ggsave(filename = "plots/lineplot_milconf.png")
ggsave(filename = "plots/lineplot_milconf.pdf")

# scale from 0-100 to show overall high level
# convert decimals to % in the labels
# insert ticks for every year
```
